reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: blobs from EL via engine_getBlobsV1/V2 are wrapped with KzgVerifiedBlob::from_execution_verified (L434 in fetch_blobs/mod.rs) which skips KZG verification, then published to P2P network via publish_blobs_gradually (network_beacon_processor/mod.rs L914-919). However, per 01e_PARTIAL_W3B4_1771748827.json property PROP-57888860-asm-003, this property is explicitly marked bug_bounty_eligible=false and exploitability=conditional with reachability classification=internal-only, entry_point=EngineAPI, attacker_controlled=false, bug_bounty_scope=conditional. The BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json trust_assumptions.engine_api section states Engine API is SEMI_TRUSTED and in-scope, but attacks requiring a compromised local EL are conditional/lower severity. This finding requires a compromised or buggy local EL to inject invalid blobs—the EL and CL are co-located with JWT authentication. The 01e property definition itself acknowledges this is a trust boundary issue, not an exploitable vulnerability with current threat model. DISPUTED_FP: trust boundary by design, not exploitable without compromising the local EL which is out of normal attack scope.
